column1: # Curated from Euskaltzaindia Araua 196 (EBO I, "Laburtzapenak: laburdurak eta
# siglak") and the EIMA "Ortotipografia" style guide (J. R. Zubimendi, Eusko
# Jaurlaritza 2004), "Laburdurak" section. The exhaustive reference is Euskalterm's
# Norm: a laburdura carries a period and is read as the FULL word (Araua 196;
# Ortotipografia s9); "etab." is a fixed exception meaning "eta abar". The lemma
# (uninflected) form is used here; running-text case is not re-derived.
# Matching is case-insensitive on the written form; the trailing period is part
# of the abbreviation and is stripped before lookup (see abbreviations.py).
# This file is data, not code: add a cited row to extend coverage.
